# PortTools submodule (Movements-Web)

This folder is a **git submodule** — the same GitHub repo as `Compliance-Web/PortTools`.

**Do not edit here first.** Edit in **`Compliance-Web/PortTools`**, push PortTools, then sync:

```powershell
cd C:\Projects\Compliance-Web
npm run sync:porttools
```

Full workflow: **`Compliance-Web/docs/porttools-git-workflow.md`**
